newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Aerospace hits record after news.
newsitem.headline: China Aerospace hits record after news.

text.p: Shares of China Aerospace International Holdings Ltd jumped sharply to a record high of HK$2.85 in early Tuesday trade after news that the company would raise HK$535 million by issuing 223.2 million new shares.
"People are buying the same fund raising for asset injection story," said Patrick Chia, research manager at China Everbright.

Chia said he feared the electronics manufacturer might see profit-taking pressure in the short run although medium-term prospects looked good. China Aerospace shares retreated slightly to HK$2.775, up HK$0.10 after the first 45 minutes.

China Aerospace said earlier the money raised from the new share issue will be mainly used for the development a cable broadcasting network, establishing manufacturing capability and a sales network for digital receiving decorders and a satellite broadcasting network in China.
